info.prompt: Cyberpunk cathedral confession booth, fish-eye lens: the sinner's side glows with pulsing cyan veins while the priest's compartment drips with molten gold filigree, a single bio-luminescent die balanced perfectly between them on a razor-thin synaptic bridge, both participants' heartbeats visible as overlapping magenta waveforms in the air, the 40Hz sub-bass making dust vibrate in the laser-grid lighting.
